rows.label: Green Lantern
rows.description: multiple superheroes from the DC universe

rows.label: Batman
rows.hook: is a wealthy Gotham industrialist who fights crime in a cape and cowl after his parents were murdered

rows.label: Superman
rows.description: superhero appearing in DC Comics publications
rows.hook: is the archetypal caped hero from the planet Krypton, with powers of flight and super strength

rows.label: Power Rangers
rows.hook: turns teenagers into color-coded costumed fighters, adapting footage from a Japanese action series

rows.label: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
rows.hook: follows four brothers named for Renaissance artists who train in martial arts to fight evil

rows.label: X-Men
rows.description: fictional superhero team in Marvel Comics
rows.hook: is a team of mutant heroes created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby, led by a telepathic professor

rows.label: Wonder Woman
rows.description: superhero appearing in DC Comics publications and related media
rows.hook: is an Amazon princess and daughter of Zeus who fights with a golden lasso

rows.label: Doctor Strange
rows.hook: stars an arrogant surgeon turned Sorcerer Supreme who guards the Earth against mystical threats

rows.label: Fantastic Four
rows.hook: is Marvel's first superhero family, whose members gained powers from cosmic rays in space

rows.label: Justice League
rows.description: group of fictional superheros of DC Comics
rows.hook: assembles DC's all-star heroes, such as Batman and Superman, into one team

rows.label: Aquaman
rows.hook: is the king of the seas who communicates with marine life and wields a golden trident

rows.label: Black Panther
rows.hook: is a king and protector of a technologically advanced African nation rich in vibranium

rows.label: Thor
rows.hook: is a hammer-wielding hero based on the Norse god of thunder
